  THEME  STYLE            COLORS (256)
* lyna   dark             color77 color75 color214 color203 color255 color102
  light  light            color29 color26 color94 color160 color235 color59
  ansi   terminal colors  color2 color4 color3 color1 color15 color7

* is the configured theme (ui.theme in <config>).
Switch with: lyna-tmux theme <name>
Give Claude Code matching themes with: lyna-tmux theme claude
